onboarding.step1Title: What do you want to work on?
onboarding.step1Subtitle: Start with one clear goal. You can add more later.
onboarding.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Study consistently for my exams
onboarding.step2Title: Why does this matter to you?
onboarding.step2Subtitle: Understanding your "why" makes it easier to stay consistent when motivation dips.
onboarding.motivationPlaceholder: e.g. I want to feel confident in my exams and prove to myself I can be disciplined.
onboarding.step3Subtitle: Knowing your main obstacle helps me give you more useful coaching.
onboarding.step4Title: How much time can you commit daily?
onboarding.step4Subtitle: Be realistic. A small habit done consistently beats a big one abandoned.
onboarding.step5Title: How should I hold you accountable?
onboarding.step5Subtitle: Choose the coaching style that works best for you.
onboarding.styleGentleDesc: Supportive and understanding — I'll meet you where you are.
onboarding.styleBalancedDesc: Honest but kind — the best default for most people.
onboarding.styleStrictDesc: No excuses — I'll push you to follow through on your commitments.
onboarding.styleGentleTone: That's okay. Let's understand what got in the way and make tomorrow easier.
onboarding.styleBalancedTone: You missed today, but the goal still matters. Let's adjust the plan and protect tomorrow.
onboarding.styleStrictTone: You committed to this. What specific obstacle blocked execution, and what will you change tomorrow?
onboarding.step6Title: When should I check in with you?
onboarding.step6Subtitle: Pick the time you are most likely to reflect on your day.
onboarding.step7Subtitle: I've suggested 3 daily habits to get you started. Uncheck any you don't want.
onboarding.changeLaterNote: You can change all of these preferences later in Settings.
onboarding.errorSubmit: Something went wrong. Please try again.
onboarding.fallbackHabit1Description: Set a timer and focus exclusively on this task.
onboarding.fallbackHabit2Description: Spend 5 minutes each evening reviewing what you will do next.
onboarding.fallbackHabit3Description: Write one sentence about what you accomplished today.

memory.title: Memory
memory.infoTitle: What the coach remembers about you
memory.infoBody: These are the durable facts your coach uses to personalize guidance — commitments you've made, preferences, constraints, and context. You can inspect, correct, or delete any of them at any time.
memory.addFactHint: Tell your coach something you want it to remember. User-authored facts outrank model-extracted ones.
memory.addFactPlaceholder: e.g. I train best in the early morning before work
memory.emptyBody: Your coach will learn about you as you converse, or you can add one above.
memory.forgetConfirmMessage: This removes it from your coach's memory. You can add it again later.
memory.forgetAllConfirmMessage: This permanently deletes every fact your coach has remembered about you. The coach will start fresh on the next conversation. This action cannot be undone.
memory.forgetAllError: Failed to forget all memory facts
